alerts.reason: Kadant’s reported Q1 consolidated revenue fell 4% year over year (A). Record demand for parts and consumables helped lift total bookings 3%, supporting a forecast that Q2 revenue growth stays above -5% (B). Capital bookings fell as customers took longer to place orders (C, D). Those delays could reduce Q3 capital-equipment revenue enough to push the consolidated decline to 5% or more.

Year-over-year net sales growth swung from +4.10% in December to -1.01% in March (A). The prior-year churro promotion accounted for some of the March weakness, and Food Service also lost pretzel volume (B, E). I forecast June-quarter growth above -5.00%, then a decline of at least 5.00% in the quarter starting June 29 if pretzel volume losses persist and deepen.

Reported consolidated revenue fell 3.92% year over year in March (A). Total bookings grew 3%, with parts and consumables accounting for 74%, supporting a June-quarter forecast above -5.00% (B). Capital orders took longer to secure and capital bookings fell (C, D). I expect those delays to weigh on later shipments and push reported revenue growth to -5.00% or lower in the quarter starting June 29.
